_note: Pronunciations used by az narrate for every episode. A value in slashes is misaki phonemes, e.g. "Aquarion": "/əkwˈɛɹiən/"; anything else is a respelling read as written, e.g. "Bifrost": "BIFF-rost". Keys starting with _ are ignored. Episode folders can add their own lexicon.json beside script.txt.
